module.Title: Visit Every Rock
module.Teaching: A foreach loop runs once for every element in a collection.
module.PredictionQuestion: How many times does the loop run?
module.PredictionExplanation: foreach automatically visits each element in the collection.
module.DebugPrompt: The loop header needs an element type and a temporary variable name.
module.RecallPrompt: Write the rock foreach loop from memory. Use these exact identifiers: Console, WriteLine, in, rocks.
module.TransferPrompt: Print every enemy in enemies. Use these exact identifiers: Console, WriteLine, foreach.
module.PreviewMessage: The renderer can now visit every rock.
